# Three Extra Attacks (`features:fighter-three-extra-attacks`)
**Class:** [Fighter](../classes/fighter.md) | **Level:** [Fighter 20](../levels/fighter-20.md)

You can attack four times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
